newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK INTRACOM, SIEMENS GET OTE TELECOMS PROCUREMENT.
newsitem.headline: GREEK INTRACOM, SIEMENS GET OTE TELECOMS PROCUREMENT.

text.p: The board of directors of Greek telecoms OTE assigned the procurement of 338,000 digital switches and corresponding circuits to Intracom and Siemens Hellas on Tuesday, it said in a statement.

The procurement is worth 20.45 billion drachmas and OTE has asked for an extra discount of 2.0 percent in addition to materials valued at 2.441 billion drachmas offered free of charge by the two firms, it said.
"The agreed upon terms are deemed absolutely satisfactory because the initial bids were improved with discounts ranging from 15 to 20 percent," it said.
The agreed upon discounts, especially for extentions of existing digital centres, were 4.0 percent lower than those achieved in a recent international tender, it added.

OTE also approved the introduction and building of the 1996 version of software and services AS8 (AXE 10-Ericson) and APS9 (EWSD-Siemens) to become more competitive at the EU level, modernise its network and improve its services, it said. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
